what: 3.3 Focal Buffer Zonal Analysis with d4h_indicator_buffer()
title: Case 04 - GPS House Buffers & Proximity to Water

code: # Execute focal buffer analysis (150m buffer = 3 cells of 50m) res_buffer <- d4h_indicator_buffer(   indicator        = "NDVI",   houses           = houses_file,   radius           = 3,             # 3 grid units   cell_size        = 50,            # 50m cell size -> 150m buffer radius   radius_in_meters = FALSE,   nir              = path_nir,   red              = path_r,   square           = FALSE,         # Hexagonal grid within buffer   mask_outside     = TRUE,          # Masks non-focal areas outside buffer   house_color      = "red",   house_size       = 2.5,   palette          = "viridis",   limits           = c(0.1, 0.9),   title            = "Peridomestic Vector Flight Radius (150m) - Focal Canopy NDVI",   plot             = TRUE )  # Inspect focal zonal statistics head(res_buffer$grid)

title: Case 04 - GPS House Buffers & Proximity to Water
text: Using segmented water bodies flight footprint, d4h_distance_to_water() measures minimum Euclidean distance (dmind_{\text{min}}) household closest water body calculates exponential proximity score: ProximityScorei=exp⁡(−dmin()λ)\text{ProximityScore}_i = \exp\left(-\frac{d_{\text{min}}()}{\lambda}\right) λ\lambda represents characteristic dispersal radius vector mosquitoes (e.g., λ=100 m\lambda = 100\text{ m} Aedes aegypti 150 m150\text{ m} Anopheles):

Extract household spatial features from the buffer result casas_sf <- res_buffer$houses  # 3. Calculate Euclidean distance and vector proximity scores water_proximity_sf <- d4h_distance_to_water(   buildings        = casas_sf,   sources          = water_sf,   decay_lambda     = 100.0,   buffer_breaks    = c(50, 100, 200),   proximity_labels = c("Immediate Proximity (<50m)", "High Proximity (50-100m)", "Moderate Proximity (100-200m)", "Distal (>200m)") )  # Inspect household distance metrics and proximity tiers head(as.data.frame(water_proximity_sf[, c("dist_water_m", "nearest_water_id", "proximity_score", "proximity_level")]))

Spatial Zonation & Surveillance Grids: Tessellate flight footprint operational hexagonal grids (d4h_hex_grid()) compute zonal summaries (d4h_summarize_grid()) community health teams larviciding logistics. Executive Reporting & Excel Export: Generate multi-moment descriptive statistics, spatial surface coverage hectares, Tukey outlier diagnostics automated multi-sheet Excel workbook export (d4h_executive_summary(), d4h_export_summary()).
